item.title: Trump to address nation with 'important update' on Iran
item.summary: President Donald Trump will address the nation Wednesday night to give an "important update" on Iran as the war continues in its fifth week.

item.title: Iran live updates: Trump is considering withdrawing US from NATO
item.summary: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with massive joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: Artemis II live updates: Artemis II crew lifts off, crosses boundary into space
item.summary: Artemis II will carry a four-person crew on a 10-day journey around the moon.

item.title: WATCH: Eight-year-old dances down hallway after beating cancer
item.summary: A heartwarming moment as 8-year-old Royce rings the bell to celebrate the end of his cancer treatment for leukemia at a children’s hospital in Fort Worth, TX, even hitting a cartwheel along the way.

item.title: Quadruple amputee cornhole champion acted in self-defense in fatal shooting: Attorney
item.summary: The victim -- 27-year-old Bradrick Michael Wells -- was found dead in a yard in Charlotte Hall, Maryland, authorities said.

item.title: WATCH: Video shows boat in Florida spinning out of control in deadly accident
item.summary: Firefighters said a woman and man were thrown from the boat and run over, killing the woman.

item.title: Johnson, Thune announce plan to end DHS shutdown but could face long road
item.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson and Senate Majority Leader John Thune announced a plan for the Republican-controlled Congress to fully fund DHS "in the coming days."

item.title: WATCH: Artemis II crew lifts off for the moon
item.summary: Artemis II has launched, taking four astronauts around the moon for the first time in more than 50 years. The Artemis II crew lifted off at 6:35 p.m. ET from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

item.title: WATCH: The science behind how astronauts’ bodies respond in space
item.summary: ABC News’ Linsey Davis spoke with UCLA director of space medicine Dr. Haig Aintablian on how astronauts are preparing for their trip to space ahead of the Artemis II launch.

item.title: WATCH: Business owner hit with mystery shipment of 600 French onion dips
item.summary: ABC News' Danny New reports on the unexpectedly robust shipment of French onion dip that landed on a Philadelphia business owner after asking for a sample.
